_comment: The approvals package's rights, shipped as a library layer (docs/commerce_PRD.md §4.13). They name only its own
ApprovalRequest type and only @authenticated: no slot, so no application has to bind anything, even one that
gets this layer through the identity provider or the organizations package (an unbound slot would refuse its
startup). Every request is narrowed per row (ApprovalRequestActions: requester, deciders, VisibleTo) and every
decision asks the kind's live gate, so the rights alone promise nothing. ApproveProposal/<Type> is the
application's to grant, per type listed under Spark:Approvals:Types.
Opt out of all of these with "libraries": { "approvals": false }.
